Expo/React Native: maintain scalable structure: `assets/`; `src/` logic, with `src/components/`, `src/screens/`, `src/navigation/` (if not using Expo Router’s `app/`), `src/hooks/`, `src/utils/`, `src/services/`. Directories `kebab-case`; components `PascalCase`; hooks/utils and variables/functions `camelCase`; global constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Components use `PascalCase`.

Always use functional components. All new code must be in TypeScript. Centralize styles with React Native `StyleSheet`.

Use Expo Router file-based routing in `app/`: `app/_layout.tsx`, `app/index.tsx`, `app/profile/[id].tsx`; avoid manual stack/tab setup in one file. Manage state immutably: Always create new objects/arrays when updating state. Carefully manage `useEffect` dependency arrays.

Use `.env` and `EXPO_PUBLIC_` for client-side values (e.g. `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`); Never store sensitive keys (e.g., private API keys) in `EXPO_PUBLIC_` variables. They are bundled client-side. Use EAS Secrets for server-side secrets.

Optimize selectively with `React.memo`, `useCallback`, `useMemo`; lazy-load large-app screens using `React.lazy` and `Suspense` (`./LazyScreen`). Handle async errors with `try/catch`, log failures, and show user-friendly messages. Add a global error boundary (`src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx`) in `App.tsx` or `_layout.tsx`.

Test with Jest & React Testing Library; target ≥80% coverage and test interactions (`src/components/Button.test.tsx`
